faq.title: Challenge FAQ
faq.description: Got questions about drawdown rules, evaluation phases, or payouts? We have answers.

items.q1: What happens if I breach a drawdown limit?
items.a1: If you breach the 5% daily drawdown or 10% total drawdown limit, the challenge account is failed. However, you can reset the account at a discounted registration fee anytime.
items.q2: When is my evaluation fee refunded?
items.a2: Eligible evaluation fees may be returned after a successful evaluation outcome and an approved first performance reward, subject to program terms.
items.q3: What payment and payout methods are supported?
items.a3: We support major credit cards, bank transfers, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, BTC, ETH) for registration fees and fast payout distributions.
items.q4: Are there minimum or maximum trading day limits?
items.a4: There are zero maximum trading day limits. You can take as long as you need to pass. The minimum trading requirement is only 4 active trading days per phase.
items.q5: Can I use Expert Advisors (EAs) and copy trade?
items.a5: Yes! EAs, indicators, and copy trading are permitted as long as they represent unique trading strategies and do not involve latency arbitrage or hedging.
items.q6: How often can I request a profit payout?
items.a6: Participants who successfully complete an evaluation may request eligible performance rewards according to the published program schedule and terms.
